theorems.name: Submission.convex_poincare_smooth_lintegral_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (O : Set (Rn n)) (w : Rn n → ℝ), IsOpen O → Bornology.IsBounded O → Convex ℝ O → ContDiff ℝ 1 w → ∫⁻ x in O, ‖w x - (volume O).toReal⁻¹ * ∫ y in O, w y‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 ^ n * Metric.diam O) * ∫⁻ x in O, ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ₑ
